result:
I moved the "Team Created" success notification into the mutation hook, so the new code now follows the rule. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **`features/teams/api/create-team.ts`:** `useCreateTeam` now calls `useNotifications` and shows the success notification in its `onSuccess`. It does this after invalidating the teams query and before calling any `onSuccess` the caller passes in.
- **`features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`:** I removed the `useNotifications` import and call. The component now just calls `useCreateTeam()`.
- **`src/app`:** I searched it and found no `useNotifications` calls, so the new `teams.tsx` route needed no change.

The existing components for discussions, comments and users also call `useNotifications` directly, so they break the same rule. I left them alone because the review was about the uncommitted change.
